Left fused benzene ring/four-membered ring part: the benzene ring has 6 C-C heavy-atom bonds, and the fused four-membered ring further contributes 4 heavy-atom bonds that are not counted repeatedly, for a total of 10. The middle/right non-phenyl connection count is 8: central N-lower N, ring carbon-side-chain carbon, side-chain carbon-imine carbon, imine C=N, imine carbon-right N, right N=C, C-O, and C-Ph. method.method_draft: Segment the image into fragments and count heavy-atom bonds in each. First count the left fused benzene/four-membered ring system: the benzene ring contributes 6 C–C bonds, and the fused four-membered ring contributes 4 additional non-shared heavy-atom bonds, giving 10 without double-counting the fused bond. Next count the remaining visible non-phenyl heavy-atom connections on the central/right side: central N–lower N, ring carbon–side-chain carbon, side-chain carbon–imine carbon, imine C=N, imine carbon–right N, right N=C, C–O, and C–Ph, giving 8. Finally expand the Ph abbreviation as a phenyl ring and add its 6 internal C–C bonds. Ignore the N–H bond, the free H+, charges, and all arrows. Sum 10 + 8 + 6 to obtain 24.

method.method_draft: Reconstruct a heavy-atom adjacency graph from the drawing. For each heavy atom, count how many heavy neighbors it has: include the three heavy neighbors of the central N but not its H, include the O–C connection only once, include both imine-type C=N links as single adjacencies, include the C–Ph attachment, and expand Ph so its six ring C–C adjacencies are present. After all heavy atoms are assigned their heavy-neighbor degrees, add the degrees; the total degree should be 48. Divide by 2 because every bond is counted at both endpoints, giving 24 heavy-atom bonds.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是一个过渡态结构，左侧有一个苯环与上方杂环/稠环骨架相连；中间有一个标注为 N–H 的氮原子；右侧还有含 N、O 的片段，并连接一个 Ph 苯基。图中还有正负电荷标记和弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头，并且不计入与氢相连的键。

再推理：按重原子邻接图计数，每条重原子—重原子连接在两个端点各计一次。左侧稠合苯环中，两个稠合碳各有 3 个重原子邻居，另外四个苯环碳各有 2 个重原子邻居，贡献度数 3+3+4×2=14。上方稠环的另外两个碳分别贡献 2 和 3。中心 N 不计 N–H，只计三个重原子邻居，贡献 3。右侧骨架中依次的 C、C=N 片段、两个 N、与 O/Ph 相连的 C、O 分别按重原子邻居数贡献 2、3、2、2、3、1。Ph 要展开为完整苯环：ipso 碳连接两个环碳和外部 C，度数为 3，其余五个环碳各为 2，贡献 3+5×2=13。

总度数为 14+2+3+3+2+3+2+2+3+1+13=48。每条键被两个端点各计一次，所以重原子键总数为 48/2=24。
